validatedCitations.excerpt: Prepared statements define SQL code first and pass user values as parameters later.

validatedAnswer: Prepared statements prevent SQL injection by separating the SQL code from the user input. The database first defines the SQL code and later passes the user values as parameters, ensuring that the database can distinguish between code and data. This prevents malicious input from being executed as part of the SQL statement.
